C0_task_e_status: not assigned a neural uncertainty ranking; C0 is retained for Task P
D_cal_role: implementation validation only; no endpoint selection or performance tuning
mean_calibration: none; raw method means are mandatory
method_curve: retain the lowest-uncertainty evaluation mass at each removal fraction
normalization: area(method - oracle) divided by area(random - oracle)
oracle_curve: retain the lowest-absolute-error evaluation mass at each removal fraction
test_summary: unweighted mean of the 40 per-volume AUSE values
tie_handling: fractional tied-group inclusion using the tied group's weighted mean error
within_volume_pooling: all supported pixels across every slice belonging to the volume
